name: meeting-agenda-load
description: Load a parked meeting agenda into this live call. Voice-only. Pass agenda_id from the queued list in the prompt. Returns the agenda, including anything left from earlier calls. Fails if the agenda is expired, finished, or held by another call.

inputs.agenda_id: string (required — id of a pending agenda from the queued list)

outputs.agenda: object (agenda snapshot: agendaId, title, topics, role, context, source, sensitivity, scheduledFor, history)
